calendar.quarter_semantics: Calendar quarters. 2026Q2 means the three months ending 30 June 2026, and the snapshot is as at that date. Every published reporting quarter is a COMPLETED period; no partial quarter is published as an actual.
calendar.macro_semantics: A macro row is identified by BOTH its anchor reporting_quarter and its macro_target_quarter. quarter_offset is target minus anchor, from -4 through +15. A positive offset is a forecast made at the anchor, never an observed future quarter, and it does not add a reporting period.
calendar.note: Twenty reporting slots exist. Only the populated ones carry observations; the missing ones are named above rather than implied.

columns.name: rating_source
columns.definition: Permitted source reference.

columns.name: rating_approver_reference
columns.definition: Approval reference, redacted as required.

columns.name: rating_missing_reason

columns.name: current_ratio
columns.definition: Current assets / current liabilities.

columns.name: quick_ratio
columns.definition: (Eligible cash + short-term investments + net trade receivables) / current liabilities. Eligible cash excludes restricted cash; the exclusions are recorded in quick_ratio_basis.

columns.name: cash_ratio
columns.definition: (Eligible cash + short-term investments) / current liabilities.

columns.name: liquidity_ratio
columns.definition: The bank's own liquidity ratio, whose definition is mandatory and is carried in liquidity_ratio_basis. Where it is identical to the current or cash ratio it is an ALIAS, not an independent signal.

columns.name: operating_cash_flow_to_current_liabilities
columns.definition: Operating cash flow / current liabilities.

columns.name: working_capital_to_total_assets
columns.definition: Working capital / total assets.

columns.name: liquid_assets_to_total_assets
columns.definition: Defined liquid assets / total assets.

columns.name: dscr
columns.definition: Cash available for debt service / matched debt service due. The bank's own basis is preserved in dscr_basis and is not replaced by a generic EBITDA-over-debt-service formula.

columns.name: interest_coverage_ratio
columns.definition: EBIT / gross interest expense.

columns.name: ebitda_interest_coverage
columns.definition: EBITDA / gross interest expense.

columns.name: fixed_charge_coverage_ratio
columns.definition: Source-defined fixed-charge coverage. The numerator add-backs and the lease and principal treatment are recorded in fixed_charge_coverage_basis.

columns.name: operating_cash_flow_to_debt
columns.definition: Operating cash flow / total debt.

columns.name: free_cash_flow_to_debt_service
columns.definition: Free cash flow / matched debt service due.

columns.name: net_debt_to_ebitda
columns.definition: Net debt / EBITDA on the stated period basis. A negative EBITDA makes this economically uninterpretable and it is flagged rather than hidden.

columns.name: debt_to_ebitda
columns.definition: Total debt / EBITDA on the stated period basis.

columns.name: debt_to_equity
columns.definition: Total debt / shareholders equity.

columns.name: liabilities_to_assets
columns.definition: Total liabilities / total assets.

columns.name: equity_to_assets
columns.definition: Shareholders equity / total assets.

columns.name: long_term_debt_to_capital
columns.definition: Long-term debt / (long-term debt + shareholders equity).

columns.name: tangible_net_worth_to_debt
columns.definition: Tangible net worth / total debt.

columns.name: gross_profit_margin
columns.definition: Gross profit / revenue.

columns.name: ebitda_margin
columns.definition: EBITDA / revenue.

columns.name: operating_profit_margin
columns.definition: EBIT / revenue.

columns.name: net_profit_margin
columns.definition: Net profit / revenue.

columns.name: return_on_assets
columns.definition: Net profit / average total assets, using the true opening balance. A PERIOD return unless explicitly annualized, which is stated in ratio_period_basis.

columns.name: return_on_equity
columns.definition: Net profit / average shareholders equity, on the same period rule.

columns.name: return_on_capital_employed
columns.definition: EBIT / average source-defined capital employed.

columns.name: operating_cash_flow_margin
columns.definition: Operating cash flow / revenue.

columns.name: free_cash_flow_margin
columns.definition: Free cash flow / revenue.

columns.name: total_asset_turnover
columns.definition: Revenue / average total assets.

columns.name: fixed_asset_turnover
columns.definition: Revenue / average net PPE.

columns.name: working_capital_turnover
columns.definition: Revenue / average working capital.

columns.name: inventory_turnover
columns.definition: Cost of goods sold / average inventory.

columns.name: receivables_turnover
columns.definition: Credit sales / average net trade receivables. Substituting total revenue for credit sales is a DIFFERENT ratio and is only permitted with an explicit alternate basis recorded.

columns.name: payables_turnover
columns.definition: Credit purchases / average trade payables. Substituting cost of sales is likewise a different ratio requiring an explicit basis.

columns.name: receivables_days
columns.definition: Average net receivables / credit sales x matched period days.

columns.name: inventory_days
columns.definition: Average inventory / cost of goods sold x matched period days.

columns.name: payables_days
columns.definition: Average trade payables / credit purchases x matched period days.

columns.name: cash_conversion_cycle_days
columns.definition: Receivables days + inventory days - payables days, all on the same period and basis.

columns.name: capex_to_operating_cash_flow
columns.definition: Capital expenditure / operating cash flow.
